captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a modern torchiere floor lamp with an integrated secondary reading lamp. It features a heavy round base in matte black, a slender metallic silver pole, and a wide, upward-facing cone shade at the top in an off-white color. A secondary reading arm branches off mid-post via a black collar joint; this arm can rotate horizontally around the main pole. The smaller, matching off-white reading light shade at the end of the curved arm is adjustable via a tilting joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a torchiere floor lamp featuring a circular base, a tall vertical pole, a fixed upper bowl shade, and an adjustable secondary reading arm. The reading arm should connect to the main pole with a revolute collar joint, and its small cone-shaped shade should tilt on a revolute joint at the arm's tip. Apply a black plastic material to the base and collar joints, a silver metallic finish to the poles, and an off-white matte material to both light shades.
captions.factory: Construct the main pole assembly by combining a flat cylindrical base, a tall vertical cylinder for the pole, a collar mount, and a lofted/revolved top bowl shade. For the secondary arm, create a revolving collar sleeve, a curved swept tube representing the arm, and a smaller lofted cone for the reading lamp shade. Define a revolute joint between the main pole collar and the reading arm for horizontal rotation, and a second revolute joint between the arm tip and the reading shade for vertical tilting.
